LESSON: SHAPES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Geometry 3.1 Position and By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners in pairs 
Topic 3.2: Shapes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Shapes. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-106.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 106]]

From your pupil's book (page 106)

Shapes Week 11 Lesson 4 Geometric shapes Activity Name the shapes

A is a ________ B is a ________ C is a ________ D is a ________ E is a ________

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-260.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 260]]

From your pupil's book (page 260)

PATTERNS Week 8 Lesson 5 Pattern making using shapes Example This is a pattern. On the right we put?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-119.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 119]]

From your pupil's book (page 119)

Activity Let us read 798, 191, 289, 80, 75,

921, 19, 816, 14, 710. Work to do 1. Learners in pairs or in groups to read number symbols 1 - 1000, both forward and backwards

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Shapes means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Shapes.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Shapes
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
